hypothesis.user_problem: Visitors cannot quickly decide which bounded system or capability matches their operational problem.
hypothesis.change: Replace a generic contact action with an outcome-first capability router before personal-information collection.
hypothesis.expected_effect: Increase the proportion of eligible starts that become qualified, accepted project enquiries.
hypothesis.because: The change reduces system-selection uncertainty and asks for service fit before contact data.

inclusion: new visitors who open the capability router
exclusion: returning users resuming an existing enquiry

variants.description: Current capability presentation and contact route.
Outcome-first routing with distinct system ownership and suitability feedback.

primary_metric.name: qualified accepted enquiry rate
primary_metric.numerator: confirmed enquiries accepted by the responsible intake owner

guardrails.name: critical accessibility failures
guardrails.failure_rule: No new critical or serious complete-process accessibility failure.

guardrails.name: personal fields collected
guardrails.failure_rule: No increase in personal-information fields or undisclosed collection.

guardrails.name: intake complaints
guardrails.failure_rule: No material increase in complaints or support contacts caused by the treatment.

guardrails.name: misleading expectation reports
guardrails.failure_rule: No treatment copy or art may overstate fit, result, price or response time.

guardrails.name: downstream acceptance
guardrails.failure_rule: Accepted-enquiry quality must not fall below the declared baseline tolerance.

guardrails.name: response capacity
guardrails.failure_rule: Median human response time and backlog must remain within the declared service window.

sample_size_plan.method: two-proportion comparison using the recorded baseline, significance risk and power target
sample_size_plan.baseline_source: Replace with observed qualified accepted enquiry baseline before activation.

runtime.start_condition: Instrumentation and assignment persistence pass replay tests.
runtime.end_condition: Both the calculated sample per variant and minimum runtime are reached without a guardrail stop.

stopping_rule: Do not stop for a favourable interim result; stop only for a pre-registered safety guardrail or after both minimum runtime and planned sample are reached.

decision_rule.adopt: Adopt only when the primary metric reaches the pre-registered practical and statistical threshold and every guardrail passes.
decision_rule.reject: Reject when the primary threshold fails or any guardrail vetoes the result.
decision_rule.inconclusive: Extend or redesign only under the pre-registered rule; otherwise report the result as inconclusive.
